title: Positive Metric Entropy for the Standard Map at Large Parameters
summary: We prove that the standard sine map of the two-dimensional torus has positive metric entropy with respect to normalized area for every sufficiently large positive parameter. This gives a full parameter tail, and hence answers Sinai's positive-parameter-measure conjecture affirmatively.
family_title: Positive metric entropy for the standard map

review.reason: Proves positive metric entropy for the standard map at all sufficiently large parameters.
